\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 224-225 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R228-first-pass-words-from-chapters-224-225}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a whirlpool; the top and order.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a lizard, a wild boar, a billy goat, a lamb, a calf
  \item a gem; a bud, a garment, a sandal, a fold of a garment; a bay, a mattress
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A lizard? (\textbf{lacerta, lacertae}.) A wild boar? (\textbf{aper, aprī}.) A billy goat? (\textbf{caper, caprī}.) A lamb? (\textbf{agnus, agnī}.) A calf? (\textbf{vitulus, vitulī}.) A gem; a bud? (\textbf{gemma, gemmae}.) A garment? (\textbf{vestīmentum, vestīmentī}.) A sandal? (\textbf{solea, soleae}.) A fold of a garment; a bay? (\textbf{sinus, sinūs}.) A mattress? (\textbf{culcita, culcitae}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{respōnsum, respōnsī}.) Fate? (\textbf{fātum, fātī}.) A lair? (\textbf{cubīle, cubīlis}.) Hospitality; lodging? (\textbf{hospitium, hospitiī}.) A lodging house? (\textbf{dēversōrium, dēversōriī}.) A traveller? (\textbf{viātor, viātōris}.) A woodland pass; a leap? (\textbf{saltus, saltūs}.) A peak? (\textbf{cacūmen, cacūminis}.) A yoke; a ridge?
